Cube Rule Live

Each food starts in the pool, goes to DiffusionGemma as one structured read, and lands in the row of the category it chose, sorted by confidence.

 

The Cube Rule says a food's category depends only on where its structural starch sits: one side is toast, two a sandwich, three a taco, four sushi, five a quiche, six a calzone, none a salad. Soup is an eighth category here, for a food with no starch that is liquid in a bowl or a cup. The question gives each category its side count and two or three examples. Photos are Wikipedia lead images and link to their pages. Run live sends each photo to the server this page came from. Replay animates a recorded run (seed 7, no thinking, 512-pixel photos, about a third of a second each on a DGX Spark).
